# Ninety5 Studio — Comprehensive Knowledge & Service Manifest
> Ninety5 is a full-stack product design & Next.js engineering studio based in Chennai, India, delivering brutalist, high-performance digital products for high-growth startups and global enterprises.

## Entity Overview
- Official Name: Ninety5 Studio
- Legal Identifier: Ninety5 Studio
- Founder: Mohammed Rayyan (Founder & Lead Designer, https://rayyan.ninety5.in)
- Headquarters: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
- Delivery Model: Global Remote Collective (Clients across USA, Europe, UK, Singapore, India)
- Core URL: https://ninety5.in
- Inquiries: hello@ninety5.in

## Core Specializations & Services

### 1. Graphic Design & Investor Pitch Decks
- Focus: Aggressive visual collateral, fundraising pitch decks, packaging design, and omni-channel marketing assets.
- Deliverables: Investor deck bundles (Figma, PDF, PPT), multi-ratio campaign visuals, print-ready CMYK files, and 3D spatial renders.
- URL: https://ninety5.in/services/graphic-design

### 2. Video Editing & Motion Graphics
- Focus: High-retention product walkthroughs, viral short-form clips (Reels, TikTok, Shorts), kinetic typography, and custom sound design.
- Deliverables: 4K master renders, multi-format cutdowns (16:9, 9:16, 1:1), animated subtitles, and motion graphics packages.
- URL: https://ninety5.in/services/video-editing

### 3. Branded Content Creation Suite
- Focus: Turnkey monthly content creation retainers for tech founders and marketing teams.
- Deliverables: LinkedIn slide carousels, newsletter design (Substack/Beehiiv), visual data infographics, and weekly content bundles.
- URL: https://ninety5.in/services/branded-content

### 4. Product Design (UI/UX)
- Focus: B2B SaaS dashboards, consumer applications, complex administrative portals, and AI interfaces.
- Deliverables: User research briefs, wireframe prototypes, tokenized Figma component libraries, developer handoff specs, and usability testing reports.
- Process: Discovery → Information Architecture → Hi-Fi Design → User Testing.
- URL: https://ninety5.in/services/product-design

### 2. Next.js Web Development & Frontend Engineering
- Focus: Production web apps, headless e-commerce, server-rendered applications, high-performance marketing engines.
- Stack: Next.js App Router, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Lenis Smooth Scroll.
- Standards: 100/100 Core Web Vitals, sub-second TTFB, full accessibility (WCAG AA), zero layout shift (CLS < 0.01).
- URL: https://ninety5.in/services/web-development

### 3. Design Systems Architecture
- Focus: Reusable token-driven component systems bridging Figma variables to code tokens (JSON/CSS/TypeScript).
- Outcome: 3x faster engineering velocity, elimination of design debt, multi-brand consistency.
- URL: https://ninety5.in/services/design-systems

### 4. Brand Identity & Visual Systems
- Focus: Unapologetic, brutalist visual identities, monospaced typography pairings, high-contrast dark/light palette systems.
- URL: https://ninety5.in/services/brand-identity

### 5. Cross-Platform Mobile Applications
- Focus: React Native engineering with 60fps animations, offline-first sync, and native iOS/Android bridge integrations.
- URL: https://ninety5.in/services/mobile-apps

### 6. UX Research & Conversion Audits
- Focus: Quantitative drop-off analytics, user interviews, heuristic usability testing, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
- URL: https://ninety5.in/services/ux-research

## In-House Products & Case Studies (Ninety5 Labs)

### Ujrat (Freelance Rate Calculator & Dynamic Invoicing Suite)
- Scope: In-house financial engineering tool built with React 19 for independent freelancers and agencies to eliminate underpricing and generate instant client-side vector PDF invoices.
- Tech Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, jspdf, Lucide Icons, Vercel Edge.
- Live App: https://ujrat.ninety5.in/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/rayyan-x95/ujrat
- Case Study URL: https://ninety5.in/work/ujrat
- Metrics: ₹18.4L+ in invoices generated, 5,000+ calculations, 100/100 Core Web Vitals.

### Titan (Offline-First Life OS & Productivity PWA)
- Scope: In-house Progressive Web App (PWA) designed as a comprehensive Life OS — integrating routine trackers, goal milestones, deep work timers, and personal asset management with full offline service worker caching.
- Tech Stack: Next.js / PWA, Service Workers, TypeScript, IndexedDB, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
- Live App: https://titan.ninety5.in/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Rayyan-x95/Titan
- Case Study URL: https://ninety5.in/work/titan
- Metrics: 100% Offline PWA capability, sub-50ms local database queries.

### Atlas (B2B Analytics Dashboard)
- Scope: End-to-end product design and Next.js frontend engineering for a multi-tenant enterprise analytics engine.
- Metrics Achieved: +280% user retention increase, 45% reduction in time-to-insight, $1.2B in processed data volume.
- URL: https://ninety5.in/work/atlas

### Bloom (Personalized AI Wellness Mobile App)
- Scope: Product design and React Native engineering from 0 to 50k users in 90 days.
- Metrics Achieved: 4.9★ App Store rating (10,000+ reviews), #12 in Health & Fitness category.
- URL: https://ninety5.in/work/bloom

### Forge (Developer Tooling Platform)
- Scope: Complete brand overhaul and web platform for an open-source toolchain with 80k+ GitHub stars.
- Metrics Achieved: 3.2x increase in enterprise support conversions, 25k new stars.
- URL: https://ninety5.in/work/forge

### Orbit (Async Engineering Management Suite)
- Scope: High-speed web application built for remote-first engineering teams.
- Metrics Achieved: Sub-2.1s load times on complex task boards, 40% reduction in coordination meetings.
- URL: https://ninety5.in/work/orbit

## Engagement & Pricing Models
1. **Fixed-Scope Project**: Clearly defined deliverables and timelines (MVP/Landing pages: 2–4 weeks; Full product design & build: 6–10 weeks; ₹2.5L to ₹12L / $3,000 to $15,000).
2. **Monthly Retainer**: Dedicated senior design and engineering capacity for continuous feature sprints and growth.
3. **Free 48-Hour Audit**: Zero-risk 5-minute video teardown and speed diagnostic for founders looking to optimize their existing platforms.
